about: Painted art, card faces, dashboards and card fans cleared for use on 2026-11-11 (provenance confirmed by the author). One entry per file; n is the index printed on the contact sheets build/art_contact*.jpg (48 per sheet, 6 per row). suggested_use is one of: cover, back cover, full-page plate, chapter header strip, column plate, spot; also_suits lists other workable uses. header_crop, where given, is a crop box as fractions (left, top, right, bottom) that reads well at 520 pt wide by about 173 pt high.
